mapper.select:
select c.charger_id , c.station_id , c.charger_name , c.charger_type , c.connector_type , c.charging_speed_kw , c.price_per_kwh , c.status as charger_status
, cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.operator_name , cs.station_status from charger c join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where c.charger_id = #{chargerId}

select c.charger_id , c.station_id , c.charger_name , c.charger_type , c.connector_type , c.charging_speed_kw , c.price_per_kwh , c.status as charger_status
, cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.operator_name , cs.station_status from charger c join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where c.station_id = #{stationId} order by case when c.status = '사용가능' then 1 when c.status = '사용중' then 2 when c.status = '점검중' then 3 when c.status = '고장' then 4 else 5 end , c.charger_id asc

select v.vehicle_id , v.member_id , v.model_id , v.vehicle_nickname , v.plate_number , v.is_default , v.created_at , v.updated_at
, vm.manufacturer , vm.model_name , vm.battery_capacity_kwh , vm.connector_type , vm.max_charging_speed_kw from vehicle v join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id where v.member_id = #{memberId} order by v.is_default desc, v.vehicle_id asc

select v.vehicle_id , v.member_id , v.model_id , v.vehicle_nickname , v.plate_number , v.is_default , v.created_at , v.updated_at
, vm.manufacturer , vm.model_name , vm.battery_capacity_kwh , vm.connector_type , vm.max_charging_speed_kw from vehicle v join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id where v.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} and v.member_id = #{memberId}

select r.reservation_id , r.member_id , r.vehicle_id , r.charger_id , r.reservation_date , r.start_time , r.end_time , r.current_soc , r.target_soc , r.required_kwh , r.estimated_minutes , r.estimated_cost , r.status , r.auth_code , r.verified_at , r.no_show_at , r.canceled_at , r.created_at , r.updated_at
, chs.actual_start_time as "actualStartTime" , chs.actual_end_time as "actualEndTime" , chs.actual_kwh as "actualKwh" , chs.actual_minutes as "actualMinutes" , chs.actual_cost as "actualCost" , chs.status as "chargingSessionStatus"
, cs.station_id as "stationId" , cs.station_name as "stationName" , cs.address as "stationAddress" , cs.latitude as "stationLatitude" , cs.longitude as "stationLongitude" , c.charger_name as "chargerName" , c.charger_type as "chargerType" , c.connector_type as "connectorType" , c.charging_speed_kw as "chargingSpeedKw" , c.price_per_kwh as "pricePerKwh" , c.status as "chargerStatus" , v.vehicle_nickname as "vehicleNickname" , vm.manufacturer as "manufacturer" , vm.model_name as "modelName" , vm.battery_capacity_kwh as "batteryCapacityKwh" , vm.max_charging_speed_kw as "maxChargingSpeedKw"
from reservation r
join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id
join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id
join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id
left join charging_session chs on r.reservation_id = chs.reservation_id
where r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} and r.member_id = #{memberId}

select r.reservation_id , r.member_id , r.vehicle_id , r.charger_id , r.reservation_date , r.start_time , r.end_time , r.current_soc , r.target_soc , r.required_kwh , r.estimated_minutes , r.estimated_cost , r.status , r.auth_code , r.verified_at , r.no_show_at , r.canceled_at , r.created_at , r.updated_at
, case when current_timestamp between (r.start_time - interval '5 minutes') and (r.start_time + interval '5 minutes') then true else false end as "verifyAvailable"
, cs.station_id as "stationId" , cs.station_name as "stationName" , cs.address as "stationAddress" , cs.latitude as "stationLatitude" , cs.longitude as "stationLongitude" , c.charger_name as "chargerName" , c.charger_type as "chargerType" , c.connector_type as "connectorType" , c.charging_speed_kw as "chargingSpeedKw" , c.price_per_kwh as "pricePerKwh" , c.status as "chargerStatus" , v.vehicle_nickname as "vehicleNickname" , vm.manufacturer as "manufacturer" , vm.model_name as "modelName" , vm.battery_capacity_kwh as "batteryCapacityKwh" , vm.max_charging_speed_kw as "maxChargingSpeedKw"
from reservation r
join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id
join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id
join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id
where r.member_id = #{memberId}
and r.start_time >= #{startDate} and r.start_time < #{endDate}
order by r.created_at desc, r.reservation_id desc
mapper.update: update reservation set status = '취소' , canceled_at = current_timestamp , updated_at = current_timestamp where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = '예약완료'
mapper.select: select reservation_id , member_id , charger_id , reservation_date , start_time , end_time , status , auth_code from reservation where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = '예약완료' and current_timestamp between (start_time - interval '5 minutes') and (start_time + interval '5 minutes')
mapper.update: update reservation set status = '충전중' , verified_at = current_timestamp , updated_at = current_timestamp where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = '예약완료'
update reservation set status = '노쇼' , no_show_at = current_timestamp , updated_at = current_timestamp where status = '예약완료' and start_time + interval '5 minutes' <= current_timestamp

update charger c set status = '사용가능', updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp from reservation r where r.charger_id = c.charger_id and r.status = '노쇼' and c.status = '예약중' and r.start_time + interval '5 minutes' <= current_timestamp
update reservation set status = '충전중' , updated_at = current_timestamp where status = '인증완료' and start_time <= current_timestamp and end_time > current_timestamp
mapper.insert: insert into charging_session ( reservation_id , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , actual_start_time , start_soc , status , created_at ) select r.reservation_id , r.member_id , r.vehicle_id , r.charger_id , current_timestamp , r.current_soc , '충전중' , current_timestamp from reservation r left join charging_session cs on r.reservation_id = cs.reservation_id where r.status = '충전중' and cs.session_id is null
mapper.update: update reservation set status = '완료' , updated_at = current_timestamp where status = '충전중' and end_time <= current_timestamp

update charging_session cs set actual_end_time = r.end_time , end_soc = r.target_soc , actual_kwh = r.required_kwh , actual_minutes = r.estimated_minutes , actual_cost = r.estimated_cost , status = '완료' , updated_at = current_timestamp from reservation r where cs.reservation_id = r.reservation_id and r.status = '완료' and cs.status = '충전중'
update reservation set status = '완료' , updated_at = current_timestamp where status = '인증완료' and end_time <= current_timestamp
mapper.insert: insert into charging_session ( reservation_id , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , actual_start_time , actual_end_time , start_soc , end_soc , actual_kwh , actual_minutes , actual_cost , status , created_at , updated_at ) select r.reservation_id , r.member_id , r.vehicle_id , r.charger_id , r.start_time , r.end_time , r.current_soc , r.target_soc , r.required_kwh , r.estimated_minutes , r.estimated_cost , '완료' , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from reservation r left join charging_session cs on r.reservation_id = cs.reservation_id where r.status = '완료' and r.verified_at is not null and cs.session_id is null

insert into charging_session ( reservation_id , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , actual_start_time , start_soc , status , created_at , updated_at ) select r.reservation_id , r.member_id , r.vehicle_id , r.charger_id , coalesce(r.verified_at, current_timestamp) , r.current_soc , '충전중' , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from reservation r where r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} and r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.status = '충전중' on conflict (reservation_id) do update set actual_start_time = coalesce(charging_session.actual_start_time, excluded.actual_start_time) , status = '충전중' , updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.update: update charging_session chs set actual_end_time = current_timestamp , end_soc = r.target_soc , actual_kwh = r.required_kwh , actual_minutes = greatest(1, ceil(extract(epoch from (current_timestamp - chs.actual_start_time)) / 60.0)::int) , actual_cost = r.estimated_cost , status = '완료' , updated_at = current_timestamp from reservation r where chs.reservation_id = r.reservation_id and r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} and r.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select:
select r.reservation_id , r.member_id , r.vehicle_id , r.charger_id , r.reservation_date , r.start_time , r.end_time , r.current_soc , r.target_soc , r.required_kwh , r.estimated_minutes , r.estimated_cost , r.status , r.verified_at , r.no_show_at , r.canceled_at , r.created_at , r.updated_at , chs.actual_start_time as "actualStartTime" , chs.actual_end_time as "actualEndTime" , chs.actual_kwh as "actualKwh" , chs.actual_minutes as "actualMinutes" , chs.actual_cost as "actualCost" , chs.status as "chargingSessionStatus"
, cs.station_name as "stationName" , cs.address as "stationAddress" , c.charger_name as "chargerName" , c.connector_type as "connectorType" , v.vehicle_nickname as "vehicleNickname" , vm.model_name as "modelName"
from reservation r
join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id
join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id
join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id
left join charging_session chs on r.reservation_id = chs.reservation_id
where r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.status = '완료'
and r.start_time >= #{startDate} and r.start_time < #{endDate}
order by r.start_time desc, r.reservation_id desc

select r.reservation_id , r.member_id , r.vehicle_id , r.charger_id , r.reservation_date , r.start_time , r.end_time , r.current_soc , r.target_soc , r.required_kwh , r.estimated_minutes , r.estimated_cost , r.status , cs.station_id as "stationId" , cs.station_name as "stationName" , cs.address as "stationAddress" , cs.latitude as "stationLatitude" , cs.longitude as "stationLongitude" , c.charger_name as "chargerName" , c.charger_type as "chargerType" , c.connector_type as "connectorType" , c.charging_speed_kw as "chargingSpeedKw" , c.price_per_kwh as "pricePerKwh" , c.status as "chargerStatus" , v.vehicle_nickname as "vehicleNickname" , vm.manufacturer as "manufacturer" , vm.model_name as "modelName" , vm.battery_capacity_kwh as "batteryCapacityKwh" , vm.max_charging_speed_kw as "maxChargingSpeedKw" from reservation r join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id where r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.status in ('예약완료', '인증완료', '충전중') and r.start_time >= current_timestamp order by r.start_time asc, r.reservation_id asc limit 1

select coalesce(round(sum(r.estimated_cost)), 0)::int from reservation r where r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.status = '완료' and r.start_time >= date_trunc('month', current_timestamp) and r.start_time < date_trunc('month', current_timestamp) + interval '1 month'
mapper.update: update charger c set status = '사용가능', updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp from reservation r where r.charger_id = c.charger_id and r.status = '완료' and c.status = '사용중' and r.end_time <= current_timestamp
update charger set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp where charger_id = #{chargerId}
